report.limitations: Frame FPS is rAF-based. CPU phase timings measure JavaScript/driver submission, not total GPU work. Timer query GPU ms (if supported) is nonblocking and includes ocean FFT, boat shadows and main scene together. Context switches, GC, browser UI and thermal state may affect frame gaps. Visible draw calls exclude some prior offscreen FFT work.
